corpus_scope: Controlled synthetic corpus (no external/Govdocs/DFRWS forensic files)

synthesis_methods.JPEG: PIL ImageDraw RGB with gradient backgrounds and random colored ellipses
synthesis_methods.PNG: PIL ImageDraw RGB with vertical line gradients
synthesis_methods.PDF: Synthetic PDF 1.4 string generation with basic obj, stream, xref, and trailer containing random word chunks
synthesis_methods.ZIP: Python zipfile.ZipFile deflated containing random CSV rows and random notes text
synthesis_methods.DOCX: Python zipfile.ZipFile containing [Content_Types].xml, _rels/.rels, and word/document.xml with synthetic paragraphs
synthesis_methods.XLSX: Python zipfile.ZipFile containing [Content_Types].xml, _rels/.rels, xl/workbook.xml, and sheet1.xml with float cell values
synthesis_methods.MP3: Synthetic ID3v2 header tag plus synthetic sine wave audio (sin tones) packed into 417-byte MPEG-1 Layer III frames
synthesis_methods.MP4: Synthesized ISO base media file format with ftyp box, mdat box containing random NALU bytes (0x00000001419a), and basic moov/mvhd/trak
